name: policy-reconciliation
description: Reconcile owned tables under saved structured accounting policy, with checked entity, dates, unit columns and revision-bound evidence.

name: decimal-formulas
description: Declare typed inputs and native exact-decimal formulas, inspect same-workbook dependencies, choose explicit financial rounding and verify recalculation receipts.

name: financial-execution
description: Read bounded records, sort, look up, join, age balances and calculate variance with explicit numeric policies and labelled evidence.

name: table-authoring
description: Create or register table regions, maintain names and column identities, refresh metadata and request approval to unregister tables when authoring tools are enabled.

name: table-append
description: Prepare and execute complete literal records when optional append tools are enabled; retry stored references and report committed receipts.

name: table-calculation
description: Calculate exact sums and counts from inspected tables with explicit units and source revisions.

name: resource-discovery
description: Find tables from business intent and resolve ambiguity using evidence.

name: schema-inspection
description: Inspect registered schemas, paginate columns and interpret freshness.
